tasks.title: 把 Scratch 纳入窗口级 Workbench registry
tasks.objective: 修复打开 Scratch Topic 后右侧没有任何 Tab/Region/Terminal 内容的问题。
tasks.outcome: Scratch workspace 在 active 或已有持久 Tab 时保持 Workbench slot，Topic 点击后显示对应工作面。
acceptance: App 的 mountedWorkspaces 不再无条件排除 Scratch；active Scratch workspace 能渲染 WorkspaceWorkbench。
普通 workspace 的 parked registry、Settings inert 和 native surface 可见性语义保持不变。
删除 Scratch registry 成员或恢复无条件过滤时，focused contract test 变红；生产源码存在 WorkspaceWorkbench 的调用者。

verification.ref: pnpm --filter @agentmux/desktop exec vitest run test/workspace-workbench-registry.test.ts test/topic-navigation-visible.test.ts test/workspace-topics-panel.test.tsx --maxWorkers=1
verification.proves: Scratch registry membership, Topic navigation and panel click behavior.
App registry change and tests compile cleanly.
The Workbench registry remains connected from the product shell.
